{
  "dataset_name": "postcutoff_clinical_trials_ai_20260517",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "non_industry_sponsor_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Maximum of academic and government sponsorship indicators to serve as a proxy for non-commercial funding.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "sponsorship",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a strong negative margin indicator for the SVM by explicitly combining known non-commercial sponsorship types.",
      "leakage_risk": "medium",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(academic_sponsored, government_sponsored)"
    },
    {
      "name": "global_scale_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized index combining the number of countries and international trial status.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "trial_scale",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth continuous feature that helps the linear model separate large-scale global trials from localized ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((country_count + np.maximum(international_trial, 0.0)) / 9.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "trial_rigor_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite score of randomization, blinding, and evidence strength.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "clinical_design",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates binary and continuous rigor metrics into a single linear projection, reducing sparsity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.maximum(has_randomization, 0.0) + np.maximum(has_blinding, 0.0) + evidence_strength_score) / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "ai_tech_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average of positive mentions for machine learning, deep learning, AI, and algorithms.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "technology",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a continuous severity measure of AI focus, which is more effective for SVM margins than individual sparse binary flags.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.maximum(mentions_machine_learning, 0.0) + np.maximum(mentions_deep_learning, 0.0) + np.maximum(mentions_ai, 0.0) + np.maximum(mentions_algorithm, 0.0)) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "digital_health_focus",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Maximum indicator across software, mobile app, and wearable mentions.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "technology",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups related digital health modalities into a single feature, providing a cleaner signal for the linear model.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(mentions_software, np.maximum(mentions_mobile_app, mentions_wearable))"
    },
    {
      "name": "enrollment_phase_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction term between enrollment size and trial phase, normalized to [0, 1].",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "trial_scale",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear SVM to capture the non-linear relationship where late-phase, large-enrollment trials behave differently than others.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((enrollment_bucket + 1.0) * (trial_phase_bucket + 1.0) / 24.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vulnerable_pop_inclusion",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicates if the trial includes either children or older adults.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "demographics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Consolidates age-related inclusion criteria into a single dimension, simplifying the feature space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(includes_children, includes_older_adults)"
    },
    {
      "name": "ai_risk_awareness",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Maximum indicator across bias, safety, and privacy mentions.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ethics_and_safety",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a unified measure of risk consideration, which may correlate with institutional backing and resources.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(mentions_bias, np.maximum(mentions_safety, mentions_privacy))"
    },
    {
      "name": "deployment_evidence_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of real-world deployment score to evidence strength score, with a small constant to prevent division by zero.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "evidence_metrics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights trials that are highly deployed but have lower formal evidence, a pattern that may separate different types of sponsors.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "real_world_deployment_score / (evidence_strength_score + 0.1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "commercial_viability_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of the trial's description and AI use type to determine its potential for commercialization and profit, scoring from 0.0 (purely academic/basic research) to 10.0 (highly commercial product).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a nuanced, continuous measure of commercial intent that raw keywords might miss, aligning well with the linear model's need for smooth gradients.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "regulatory_complexity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Evaluates the complexity of the trial's regulatory pathway based on disease area, phase, and AI technology used, scored from 0.0 (low burden) to 5.0 (high burden).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "High regulatory burden often requires significant funding. This semantic score gives the SVM a proxy for required capital.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "innovation_novelty_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assesses the novelty of the AI application within the specified disease area, from 0.0 (standard/routine) to 1.0 (highly novel/experimental).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Differentiates between cutting-edge research and mature applications, providing a continuous feature that helps separate funding sources.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
